{{Conjecture|legends}}
{{Quote|Everything I've done these past few years has been for the sake of the Republic and the Council. The sabotaged spaceport on Fondor, the betrayal of those who trusted me on Dathomir, the lives I sacrificed on Corellia, and scores of other hard missions. All the wrong I've done for the greater "good."|[[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], to [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]]|<ref name="Republic 54">[[Republic 54|''Republic'' 54]]</ref>}}
A '''mission''' was taken by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the assignment, Vos [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaged]] a [[Unidentified Fondor spaceport|spaceport]] on the planet.<ref name="Republic 54" />
